purpose: Document first-party Chengde registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-service access review.
assessment: Official Chengde material and the current first-party portal evidence the local Natural Resources and Planning Bureau / Real Estate Registration Center custody. The public portal provides registration and progress routes, while certificate lookup redirects to login. No safe anonymous parcel-vector response was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Chengde Real Estate Registration Center online service portal; public home page exposes progress and certificate-query entry points.
Official center introduction identifies the Chengde Real Estate Registration Center as subordinate to the Chengde Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and gives its public service role.
Anonymous GET redirects to the official /online/platform/login page; the certificate/property query is account and verification-code gated.
Official city-government description assigns the bureau responsibility for unified real-estate registration, cadastral surveys, cadastral measurement, and geospatial public services.
Official city-government report describes registration records and attached floor/parcel-map materials available through a certificate QR workflow; this is not an anonymous parcel-vector service.
